name: Aurelia Radiant Spear
loreTies: Radiant Edict: structured actions reduce chaos effects and protect allies.
Aurelia Radiant Spear is a colossal Empyrean Titan shaped by existence survives through order. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Sophia, Wisdom of the Living Choir, is one of the four playable god-Titans of the Empyrean canon. The lore remains the same; the playable form is now the source-realm divinity behind the mythology: feminine divine wisdom, living ordinance, holy geometry, terrain law made compassionate.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Aurelia Radiant Spear began as more than a weapon in The Radiant Hierarchies. Aurelia Radiant Spear was bound to a radiant archive seal during a Gate disturbance that tested whether existence survives through order could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Empyrean, Aurelia Radiant Spear is treated as proof that a radiant hierarchy of law, purpose, preservation, sacred geometry, divine halls, and anti-chaos governance can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries gold-white metals, celestial light, ordered winglike silhouettes, law sigils, halo-spine geometry, throne-like bodies, but their real identity is tactical: protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, battle lineless aura play. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Aurelia Radiant Spear; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break battle line, or turn culture into raw fuel. Aurelia Radiant Spear survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever anti-chaos seals appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Storm-Oath Covenant, Aurelia Radiant Spear gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-Titan Titan, Aurelia Radiant Spear turns Radiant Edict from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Aurelia Radiant Spear's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 32, attack 8, range 1, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.

visualCanon: Oriel is an edict-keeper formed by angelic hierarchy and living record law. Their glass tablets, bell-metal seals, layered halos, quiet dread, and wing geometry should feel like the origin of later angel-scribe legends.
